subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should the bundled Cloudflare plugin add a backward-compatible first-class Workers AI mode, or should Workers AI remain an explicitly documented generic custom-provider workflow?
rationale: The missing onboarding capability is proven, but the shipped provider is intentionally Anthropic-specific and the open REST and bridge proposals leave the permanent Cloudflare endpoint, auth, provider-identity, and model-ID contract unresolved.

options.title: Add compatible plugin mode
options.body: Preserve existing Anthropic setups and add an explicitly selected Workers AI mode owned end-to-end by the Cloudflare plugin.

options.title: Document the generic workflow
options.body: Keep the bundled provider Anthropic-only and publish an exact supported non-interactive custom-provider recipe for Workers AI.

options.title: Wait for the bridge contract
options.body: Defer implementation until the broader multi-provider Cloudflare design chooses the endpoint, auth, and model-routing contract.

recommendation.title: Add compatible plugin mode
recommendation.body: Preserve existing Anthropic setups and add an explicitly selected Workers AI mode owned end-to-end by the Cloudflare plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: The landed feature introduction and plugin-boundary refactor provide the strongest available history-based routing signal for this product choice.
